method.energy: sum of shortest-path Euler angular-speed magnitudes for 16 spine/arm/head bones, plus root_weight times pelvis/root translation speed
method.normalization: per-figure p10 -> 0 and p90 -> 1, clipped; preserves timing while compensating for performer/retarget amplitude
method.classification: CALM <= calm_threshold; FRENZY >= frenzy_threshold; MEDIUM otherwise; short runs merged to nearest adjacent class
method.collective: all six labels agree at the same current Scene 3 time for at least collective_min_seconds
method.interpretation: threshold labels are inferred aids for editorial placement, not visually accepted choreography
